content_blocks.label: clause_1._Defined_Terms
content_blocks.text: For purposes of this Agreement, the term 'Confidential Information' shall mean any and all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether in written, oral, electronic, or other form, that is marked or identified as confidential, or that, under the circumstances surrounding its disclosure, should be treated as confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Obligations_of_the_Receiving_Party
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall hold in strict confidence and shall not disclose or use the Confidential Information except as expressly authorized in writing by the Disclosing Party or as required by law, provided that the Receiving Party shall take reasonable steps to prevent unauthorized disclosure of such Confidential Information.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Duration
content_blocks.text: The obligations of confidentiality set forth in this Agreement shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years from the effective date of such termination or expiration.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of April 2024.
